summary: This 8-K reports NKGen Biotech's entry into an omnibus amendment to a secured convertible loan agreement, increasing the loan by $607,200 (net $552,000) and issuing additional convertible promissory notes and warrants. The conversion price is $0.08 per share. This is a financing transaction, not a special situation. No strategic change, acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is involved. The filing details a routine debt facility modification and equity-linked issuance, falling outside defined special-situations categories.
